questions.feedback: That overdue-tails answer is the one to unlearn: After three heads, tails is due. Reteach point: The coin has no memory: the next toss is still 1/2.

questions.prompt: In the two-toss possibility table, how many of the four equally likely outcomes are exactly one head and one tail, in either order?

questions.feedback: Scene s5: multiply along the branches, 1/2 times 1/2, which is 1/4.
